 colors=[v for v in counts if v!=0]

 r0=min(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts)

newcode='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    counts = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row)
    # The marked template is the least frequent nonzero color.
    obj = min((value for value in counts if value != 0), key=lambda value: counts[value])
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == obj]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in points)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in points)
    shape = {(r - r0, c - c0) for r, c in points}
    height = max(r for r, c in shape) + 1
    width = max(c for r, c in shape) + 1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Stamp the template wherever all of its cells cover zero.
    for r in range(len(grid) - height + 1):
        for c in range(len(grid[0]) - width + 1):
            if all(grid[r + dr][c + dc] == 0 for dr, dc in shape):
                for dr, dc in shape:
                    out[r + dr][c + dc] = obj
    return out
'''
